messages:
ci-bot: [ALERT] nightly-small-batch job detected throughput regression on runtime main (v2.3.1 -> v2.4.0). Metric: tokens/s down ~18% for batch_size=8. Job: https://perf.redwood/jobs/nightly-small-batch/1915 :warning:
Sam: seeing this now, thanks. Reassigning — @Anna can you grab the artifacts and flamegraphs?
Anna: on it. grabbing artifacts now, might take a few minutes to fetch the perf-store snapshot.
Kia: FYI we merged PR #452 yesterday (quantization kernel tweak). tagging because that touched transformer kernel selection.
Matt: letting you know i'll try to repro locally with the same model & config. queuing a local run with commit range a1b2..c3d4.
Anna: uploaded traces and flamegraphs: https://perf.redwood/artifacts/1915/flamegraphs.tar.gz. quick glance shows increased time in attention/kv_cache path for small sequences.
Sam: good find. @Matt when you run locally, please try a build that reverts PR #452 to confirm. also include --cpu-prof and the runtime kernel log (RT_LOG=kernels).
Matt: repro'd locally. small-batch tokens/s down ~15%, p99 latency up 12%. pushed profile to /artifacts/local-1915/matt-profile.pb.gz.
Anna: looking at the flamegraphs: main time is in 'kv_cache_lookup' → 'select_kernel_for_attention'. kernel_selector is preferring a different kernel variant after quant change.
eng-sre: infra note — no obvious GPU contention during the nightly window (util/temperature normal).
Sam: ok hypothesis: quant changes altered heuristics in kernel selection, causing a slower kernel to be chosen for the common small-batch path. next steps: 1) Matt run bisect to find exact commit 2) Anna capture kernel_selector logs from nightly nodes 3) Kia review PR #452 for heuristics changes 4) eng-sre keep an eye on the nightly queue for flapping.
Matt: starting bisect: bisect range a1b2..c3d4. command i'm using: 
```
# local bisect script (runs the benchmark on each commit)
./ci/tools/bisect_perf.sh --bench small-batch --model llama-7b --batch 8 --runs 5 --compare-to baseline
```
I'll post results when I have the culprit commit.
Kia: scanning PR #452 — we changed the threshold from 32->24 tokens for the new kernel, that could shift selection for short sequences. adding a note to the PR with a rollback patch.
Anna: added the kernel selection logs at https://perf.redwood/artifacts/1915/kernel_selector.log — you can see the decision tree and chosen kernel variant.
Sam: if the bisect points to that PR, we should hotfix the selector heuristics and run a canary nightly before broader rollout.
ci-bot: Re-run queued -> nightly-small-batch #1916 (triggered by @Sam).
Matt: bisect update: culprit commit is c3d4f9 (the quant heuristic adjustment). rolling a quick local revert gives metrics within 1% of baseline.
Kia: preparing a revert PR now (draft), will push CI and tag @Sam for review.
Anna: re-running the flamegraph diff after revert locally shows the attention path time restored. confirming regression was selector heuristic.
Sam: nice work team. follow-ups — Kia open PR with revert + test that locks kernel selection for small-batch; eng-sre please keep nightly reruns for the next 48h; Anna attach a short blameless note to the perf incident with links to artifacts. I'll schedule a short postmortem sync tomorrow 9:30am PT (15m). :thumbsup:
eng-sre: will monitor. setting alert to escalate if tokens/s drop >10% for two consecutive nightlies.
Kia: PR draft created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/459 — tagging owners.
Matt: will add a micro-benchmark that exercises the kv_cache path to prevent regression in future.
Sam: thanks all. closing this thread once revert is merged and nightly stabilizes. :white_check_mark:
ci-bot: Note: artifacts retained for 30 days.
